issues.on_page: NET POSITION, end of year 237,619 (modified cash basis, p6); accrual-basis statement p18 prints 470,229
issues.issue: FY2023 uses the modified cash proprietary statement (correct basis, matches the Statement of Activities). Output/json/Long_Pine_FY2024.json starts business_type at 470,229, the accrual-basis figure, so the two years do not tie (237,619 vs 470,229). The difference is the change of basis, not a restatement. The governmental fund balance ties: FY2023 ending 477,400 = FY2024 beginning 477,400. No change to FY2023.

issues.extracted: Sanitation 45,465 / Sewer 30,644 / Water 156,112 from the combined all-funds budget schedule
issues.on_page: Combined budget and actual, all fund types (p8)
issues.issue: Per-fund detail rule: combined all-funds schedule lines are normally removed, and when some funds have their own schedules, no lines are added for the others. These three utility lines (detail[63]-[65]) come from the combined schedule and have no detail_totals. Water 156,112 includes the 29,789 debt service. Keeping them is defensible but contrary to the rule.
